title: “Blog Post 1_20260527) AI Lessons from 이어드림스쿨”

date: 2026-05-27T12:00:00+09:00

Hi everyone, welcome to my blog!

I am a marketer with 11 years of professional experience in the industry. Throughout my career, I have witnessed how fast the digital landscape changes, but recently, I realized something even more profound: **AI is no longer just a tool—it is the future of everything we do.** Driven by this realization and a strong desire to stay ahead of the curve, I decided to take a bold leap. I joined **“이어드림스쿨” (Eardream School)** to immerse myself in the world of Artificial Intelligence from the ground up.
